notes.title: 1월 8일 중간 저장 기능 업데이트 및 버그 수정
notes.notes:
Your game progress will now be automatically saved under certain circumstances.
What is saved is the number of paintings acquired in each area and the crow quest progress.

Fixed an issue where the AI ​​got stuck in a wall or could not find its way properly in certain sections.

AI now misses players slightly sooner on Easy/Normal difficulties.

notes.title: January 6 Difficulty changes and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where trap textures in the maze section overlapped.
Fixed an issue where items could not be picked up in some sections.

The trap spawn rate in the maze section has been reduced by 50%.
Now, on Easy/Normal difficulties, once your stamina regeneration is complete (you can tell by whether the screen border blinks), you will no longer die if you are hit by a trap.
Player movement speed reduction after being hit by a trap has been reduced from 66% to 33%.
The time it takes for CCTV alarms to sound has increased by 75%.
Pursuer's detection range reduced by 25%


We apologize for causing you pain due to the unreasonable difficulty level and sloppy gameplay.
We will do our best to show you our progress.
thank you.

notes.title: Difficulty-related balance patch on January 5, 24
notes.notes:
On Easy/Normal difficulties, Chasers are now slower, items spawn more, and traps deal less damage.

Chaser's movement speed is reduced by 22% on Easy difficulty.
Chaser's movement speed reduced by 13% on Normal difficulty.

Item spawn maximum increased by 80% on Easy difficulty
Increased maximum item spawns by 40% on Normal difficulty

If you are hit by a trap 8 times on Easy difficulty, you die (previously 4 times).
If you are hit by a trap 6 times on normal difficulty, you die (previously 4 times).
